words.definition: The strange tangibility of old bookstores, which are filled with the souls of thousands of years gone by.
words.sentence1: She walked into the dusty antiquarian shop and was immediately enveloped by a deep sense of vellichor. (She walked into the dusty antiquarian shop and was immediately enveloped by a deep sense of vellichor.)
words.sentence2: The quiet afternoon spent flipping through vintage pages offered him a comforting vellichor. (The quiet afternoon spent flipping through vintage pages offered him a comforting vellichor.)

words.definition: The pure joy and excitement of wearing or using something for the very first time.
words.sentence1: Manana voy a estrenar mis zapatos nuevos en la fiesta. (Tomorrow I am going to wear my new shoes for the very first time at the party.)
words.sentence2: Hay una emocion unica al estrenar un libro que acabas de comprar. (There is a unique emotion in using a book you just bought for the very first time.)

words.definition: A lucky, unexpected find that brings a sudden rush of delight and fulfillment.
words.sentence1: Cette petite montre ancienne achetee au marche aux puces etait une vraie trouvaille. (This little antique watch bought at the flea market was a real lucky find.)
words.sentence2: Sa decouverte dans la petite librairie fut une trouvaille emouvante. (Her discovery in the small bookstore was a touching lucky find.)

words.definition: The profound feeling of peaceful solitude and connectedness when being alone in the deep woods.
words.sentence1: Er spuerte eine tiefe Waldeinsamkeit, als er tief in den herbstlichen Wald ging. (He felt a deep solitude in the woods as he walked deep into the autumn forest.)
words.sentence2: Die reine Waldeinsamkeit half ihr, den Stress der Stadt komplett zu vergessen. (The pure forest solitude helped her to completely forget the stress of the city.)

words.definition: An awareness of the universe that triggers emotional responses too deep and mysterious for words.
words.sentence1: Kiri no naka no yama o mite, fukai yugen o kanjita. (Looking at the mountains in the mist, I felt a deep, profound grace and mystery.)
words.sentence2: Sono keshiki wa mune o utsu yugen ni michite ita. (That scenery was filled with a profound and mysterious beauty that touched the heart.)

words.definition: The mark left on a table by a cold glass, evoking the lingering warmth of a shared conversation.
words.sentence1: Sul tavolo in legno era rimasto il culaccino del bicchiere di vino. (On the wooden table remained the condensation ring from the glass of wine.)
words.sentence2: Guardando quel culaccino, ricordo le risate della sera prima. (Looking at that glass ring, I remember the laughter from the night before.)

words.definition: A bittersweet, nostalgic longing for a distant place or a past era that feels almost tangible.
words.sentence1: Zai zhege gui de zaochen, ta xinli chongman le yiyou de ganqing. (On this quiet morning, her heart was filled with a poignant, nostalgic longing.)
words.sentence2: Lao zhaopian zongshi rang ren xianru yiyou de siwei zhong. (Old photographs always make people sink into a bittersweet longing.)

words.definition: The sudden, exhilarating realization of personal growth after overcoming a quiet inner storm.
words.sentence1: Geu sigan dwieneun maeumui sonmok-eul neukkyeotda. (After that time, I felt the quiet, blooming clarity of emotional growth.)
words.sentence2: Gyeouul kkeut-eseo geunyeoneun jasin-ui sonmok-eul maraetda. (At the end of winter, she whispered about her newfound inner strength.)

words.definition: The lingering, sweet resonance of a kind word that echoes in your heart long after it was spoken.
words.sentence1: Samngk roar chheah ban dael chol joul knong chiet ke klang nas. (The kind words left a sweet resonance that entered deep into the soul.)
words.sentence2: Komnoh chea snamru moak pi kngea del ban chreuh chreab. (That memory is a lingering sweet echo from a dear friend.)

words.definition: The profound, warm comfort found in sharing complete silence with someone you deeply trust.
words.sentence1: Hulle het saam gesit en geniet die stiltegenot op die stoep. (They sat together and enjoyed the comforting bliss of silence on the porch.)
words.sentence2: Daardie oomblik van stiltegenot was meer werd as duisend woorde. (That moment of quiet shared bliss was worth more than a thousand words.)
